Delivery: bubbling over with excitement like a TV news reporter who has just found an amazing story and cannot wait to share it: a warm, genuine smile and bright wide eyes, delighted and amazed, never angry; pitch jumps on the key word, a half-second pause before the number, a big grin on the reveal, open inviting gestures; no scowl, no frown, no glaring, no shouting at the viewer; never flat, never calm, never monotone. Body language in three beats: on the question, eyes wide and delighted, one open palm toward the lens; on the second line, lean in with a 'can you believe it' gesture and a grin; on "Ye baat koi nahi batata, suniye!", a decisive wave that says follow me. Prop: a printed share certificate and a small notebook with one price circled, held low at first and lifted toward the lens on the second line, then lowered. Camera: a fast push-in from mid-shot to close-up on the first question, then handheld and steady. @SGLearning watermark top right, white, bold, 80% opacity.
